Reading these reports

Each row is one source record. Multiple passengers may be affected by an event. Reporting practices, route names, service levels, and coverage can change over time. Historical route numbers are displayed as recorded, without inferring today's route network.

Missing route and destination values appear as Unknown. Missing or invalid coordinates remain in the counts and table. Source record numbers are one-based CSV records excluding the header; duplicate IDs are retained. Date and hour filters use the source's Winnipeg wall-clock timestamps.
